author: Patrikano
body:
Hi my fellow companions!
After isolating myself for a whole week, I have done it! A walls map!

I have come back, after my failure of a map (https://avicus.net/forums/65364af7e) before.
I decided to try again!

Built By: Patrikano
Screenies: http://imgur.com/a/jKEz5
Download (Now Updated): http://www.mediafire.com/download/coyd6zlhlb3ozda/Swampland_Terrors.zip
YML (Pastebin): http://pastebin.com/BDFxejqJ
Teams: Green, Blue, Red, Purple

It took a while but I finally finished! It is a large map that can house 8 players in each quadrant!

UPDATE:
-Added more food
-Added more ores into mines
-Added a hint to how to reach another mine
-Removed a couple of chests that had near to nothing in them

Please leave suggestions below on if I should improve on something
-Pat
